facts.text: “Magnetic” by The Bausa is in its 29th week in the Dutch Top 40.
“Patient Zero” by Taylor Swift entered the US Hot 100 straight at #1 this week.
“Dracula” by Tame Impala is in its 53rd week in the US Hot 100.
Back after 3 years: “Sweater Weather” by The Neighbourhood is in the UK Top 100 again this week.
“Mr. Brightside” by The Killers is in its 526th week in the UK Top 100.
